$comment: The namespaces each page route inlines into its HTML, by route id (routes.ts); /settings/:section has one entry per section (settings:section:<section>). The root's go with every page, so they hold only what any page may show (settings: the Settings nav, autosave status and home widget other modules render too); a route's only with its own. Namespaces only a dialog opened by a click or a card below the fold needs (settings.dialogs, settings.person-dialogs, settings.workspace-limits, -apps, -github, -rooms) are in no entry: they load on demand (modules/settings/on-demand.tsx). scripts/i18n-build.mjs reports each route's size against the budget.
